content.short: HyperSwap is a concentrated liquidity AMM and one of the principal exchanges on HyperEVM.
content.description: HyperSwap is a concentrated liquidity AMM on HyperEVM where users swap tokens, provide liquidity and earn fees from the pools they supply. It positions itself as the chain's liquidity hub, with a stated community of more than 18,000 users. As one of the most used AMMs on HyperEVM, its pools are a common routing hop for the aggregators that search the chain for the best swap price.
